description: Attach a note or highlight to a document. Requires an API key with documents:write. Give `content` for a note, `color` alone for a colour-only highlight (then `quotedContent` is required — a highlight must point at a passage). Visibility comes from ownership: on the key member's own document choose PRIVATE (only they see it) or SHARED; on anyone else's document every note is SHARED, so omit scope. Documents nobody owns — anonymous uploads and service-owned pages — take no notes at all.

content.description: Note text, up to 4000 characters. Omit for a colour-only highlight.

password.description: Plain document password, if the document has one.

quotedContent.description: Passage of the body this note points to, up to 4000 characters. Matched by text, so it survives edits elsewhere.

textStart.description: Character offset where the quote starts in the body. Optional; speeds up re-anchoring.

name: postmd_add_note
